name: English Opening
description: A flexible flank-opening course that teaches positional play, center control from the side, and calm development.

branches.title: Main Line: c4 and Nc3
branches.description: Learn the default English setup: control d5 from the side and develop flexibly.

moves.title: Control d5
moves.explanation: c4 fights for d5 from the side and keeps the center flexible.

moves.title: Develop toward d5
moves.explanation: Nc3 develops and increases control over d5. White can choose the center structure later.

hints: The key training move in this branch is Nc3.
Follow the highlighted move and keep your plan simple.
coachingNotes: Learn the default English setup: control d5 from the side and develop flexibly.

branches.title: Symmetrical English
branches.description: If Black mirrors c5, develop naturally.

moves.title: Black mirrors
moves.explanation: Black also controls d4 from the side.

moves.title: Recommended: develop
moves.explanation: Nc3 increases central control and keeps the setup flexible.

hints: The key training move in this branch is Nc3.
Follow the highlighted move and keep your plan simple.
coachingNotes: If Black mirrors c5, develop naturally.
Nc3 increases central control and keeps the setup flexible.

branches.title: Develop Against Nf6
branches.description: If Black develops a knight, continue with Nc3.

moves.title: Recommended: develop
moves.explanation: Nc3 adds central control and prepares g3 or Nf3 setups.

hints: The key training move in this branch is Nc3.
Follow the highlighted move and keep your plan simple.
coachingNotes: If Black develops a knight, continue with Nc3.

branches.title: Stay Flexible
branches.description: If Black prepares d5 with e6, keep developing.

moves.title: Black prepares d5
moves.explanation: Black supports a central pawn break.

moves.title: Recommended: develop
moves.explanation: Nc3 pressures d5 and keeps White ready for d4 or g3 plans.

hints: The key training move in this branch is Nc3.
Follow the highlighted move and keep your plan simple.
coachingNotes: If Black prepares d5 with e6, keep developing.

branches.title: Final Review
hints: The key training move in this branch is Nc3.
Follow the highlighted move and keep your plan simple.

ideas: Stay flexible before committing central pawns.
Develop naturally and avoid rushing attacks.
commonMistakes: Treating c4 like a gambit trick.
Ignoring development because the center is quiet.
Pushing too many pawns before pieces are out.
